dict.string: One-shot PriceOracle snapshotter for /price-data. Iterates the tracked oracle cohort (category=oracle in named_accounts.json — DIA at rP24Lp7bcUHvEW7T7c8xkxtQKKd9fZyra7 as of v1) via account_objects(type=oracle), routed through xrpl_client.get_client() so a load-shedding local rippled cascades to s1/s2. Decodes hex Provider/URI/AssetClass and hex-encoded AssetPrice (int / 10^Scale) before writing so the reader/template never touch hex. Replaces the oracles_snapshot table in Neon each pass; the /price-data route reads via oracle_snapshot.py (5-min TTL). 2026-07-02 full-ledger walk confirmed DIA is the one production provider on mainnet; other tag=oracle owners found were hobby-flavor (never added to the tracked cohort). New production providers get added by editing named_accounts.json with category=oracle — walker picks them up next cycle.
